home.title: Holiday Strip
home.previewLabel: Live preview of the LED matrix

brightness.label: Brightness
brightness.note: How bright the LEDs shine. Lower it for a dark room, or to draw less current.

current.title: Current draw
current.limitedDescription: The device is dimming the LEDs to stay under the limit. Lower the brightness, or raise the limit in Settings if your power supply can take it.

home.scenesDescription: Pick one scene to keep, or let the strip rotate through all of them.
home.rotateAllDescription: Cycle through every scene, one after the other

message.title: Message
message.label: Scrolling message
message.allowedHint: The matrix can draw {letters}, spaces and {punctuation}. Type {heart} for a heart. Lowercase is shown in capitals.
message.unsupportedDescription: The matrix font has no {characters}. The matrix shows each of them as a question mark (accented letters as two).

countdown.title: Countdown
countdown.label: Christmas countdown
countdown.note: In the {days} days before Christmas the strip also scrolls "MANCANO N GIORNI A NATALE!" (N is the number of days left). The countdown is always in Italian.

maxMilliamps.label: Power limit
maxMilliamps.note: The most current the LEDs may draw; the device dims them to stay under it. Set it to about 80% of what your 5 V power supply can deliver.

language.label: Language
language.note: The language of this web interface.

wifi.title: Connect to WiFi
wifi.note: The device will try the credentials immediately and disable its temporary hotspot after a successful connection.

wifi.refreshError: An error occurred while refreshing the SSID list
wifi.connectConfirmMessage: Send the selected credentials for {ssid} to the device and switch it to that network?
wifi.noNetworksDescription: The device is still scanning, or no network is in range. Scan again in a few seconds.
wifi.passwordDialogDescription: Enter the password of this network.

apSetup.title: Connect to WiFi
